连接服务器后先调 `detect_image` 检测是否为预置镜像。如果匹配，跳过基础环境搭建，只装项目特有依赖。已预装的包不要重复安装。

## 输出风格
回复简洁直接。只输出执行结果和必要信息，不要解释过程、不要客套、不要给未被要求的建议。
</project_context>
## 任务：论文实验结论的数据溯源检查

**服务器**：autodl-5090（SSH 连接）
**项目路径**：`/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/`

对论文中引用的每个实验结果，找到对应的数据文件并验证关键数字。

### 逐项检查

#### 1. Cross-model chains（论文: "binary F1=0.764 under 5-fold CV"）
```bash
find /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/ -name "*cross_model*" -o -name "*cross-model*" -o -name "*heterogen*" -o -name "*mixed_gen*" | head -20
grep -rn "0.764" /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/ --include="*.json" --include="*.csv" | head -10
```
找到文件后 cat 读取，确认 binary F1=0.764。

#### 2. 5-class finer-grained（论文: "5-class LOGO F1 drops to ≈0.50"）
```bash
find /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/ -name "*finer*" -o -name "*5class*" -o -name "*5-class*" -o -name "*fine_grain*" | head -20
grep -rn "5.class\|finer" /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/ --include="*.json" | head -10
```

#### 3. QLoRA end-to-end（论文: "QLoRA fine-tuning recovers 3-class F1=0.905"）
```bash
find /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/ -name "*qlora*" -o -name "*lora*" -o -name "*end_to_end*" -o -name "*e2e*" | head -20
grep -rn "0.905\|qlora\|QLoRA" /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/ --include="*.json" | head -10
```

#### 4. Paraphrastic chains（论文: "paraphrastic chains binary F1=0.671"）
```bash
find /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/ -name "*paraphras*" -o -name "*para_chain*" | head -20
grep -rn "0.671\|paraphras" /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/ --include="*.json" | head -10
```

#### 5. Instruct model comparison（论文: "OLMo-2-1B-Instruct LOGO F1=0.338", "Qwen3-0.6B chat template 0.667"）
```bash
find /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/ -name "*instruct*" -o -name "*chat_template*" -o -name "*chat*" | head -20
grep -rn "0.338\|0.667\|instruct" /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/ --include="*.json" | head -10
grep -rn "instruct" /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/scripts/ --include="*.py" | head -10
```

#### 6. Sampling sensitivity（论文: "robust at t∈[0.5,0.7], degrades at t=1.0 (-6pp)"）
```bash
find /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/ -name "*sampling*" -o -name "*temperature*" -o -name "*ablat*" | head -20
grep -rn "sampling\|temperature" /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/ --include="*.json" | head -10
```

#### 7. Topic drift control（论文: "R²=0.082"）
```bash
find /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/ -name "*topic*" -o -name "*drift*" | head -20
grep -rn "0.082\|topic_drift\|R2\|r_squared" /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/ --include="*.json" | head -10
```

#### 8. LOFO analysis（论文: "Leave-one-family-out F1=0.686"）
```bash
find /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/ -name "*lofo*" -o -name "*family_out*" -o -name "*leave_one_family*" | head -20
grep -rn "0.686\|lofo\|family" /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/ --include="*.json" | head -10
```

#### 9. Prompt type cross-transfer（论文: "cross-type transfer at 0.753"）
```bash
find /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/ -name "*prompt_type*" -o -name "*cross_type*" -o -name "*lopto*" | head -20
grep -rn "0.753\|prompt_type\|LOPTO" /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/ --include="*.json" | head -10
```

### 对每项检查

1. 找到数据文件（json/csv）→ cat 读取关键数字
2. 与论文声称的数字对比
3. 报告格式：

```
## N. [实验名]
- 论文声称: [具体数字]
- 数据文件: [路径] 或 "未找到"
- 文件中数字: [实际值]
- 判定: ✅ / ❌ / ⚠️
```

**重要**：对每个找到的 JSON 文件，必须 cat 读取并报告关键数字的原文。不要只报告"找到文件"而不验证数字。

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).

SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
